name: beatthescam-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end tests for the two dynamic surfaces (AI scam checker, newsletter double opt-in). Hermetic: serves the committed dist/ and runs the real Netlify Function handlers in-process with stubbed upstreams — no network, no real API keys, no real emails. Deliberately separate from the root package.json, which exists solely so Netlify bundles @netlify/blobs.
